title: Non-anchor position period prediction v20
rationale: This lane is limited to a predeclared position-period rule over absolute K4 position numbers. It does not use public known-plaintext anchors, additive fragment values, candidate words, or prior key-material hits as discovery evidence.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should fall into one or more registered period residue classes at a rate exceeding seeded null and best-of-period controls.
discovery_inputs: Registered period set from the structural-model command family
Residue-class rule fixed before adding or scoring any new source-backed observations
evaluation_inputs: Future source-documented non-anchor K4 position observations with source IDs, one-based positions, notes, and rationale
Observation archives validated before period scoring and not derived from public known-plaintext anchor fragments
controls: seeded shuffle baseline over non-anchor K4 positions
multiple-comparison correction across registered periods and residue classes
